answer.title: Scenario answer
answer.body_html: For family relocation to Dubai, the best property choice usually depends on schools, commute, budget, family size, handover timeline, community maturity and whether the family wants an apartment, townhouse or villa. The safest shortlist should balance lifestyle, daily logistics and long-term resale logic.

scenario_logic.title: Scenario logic
scenario_logic.body: Primadom AI should rank family relocation options by daily-life fit first: school access, commute, community maturity, property size, outdoor space, noise, safety perception, handover risk, payment plan and total relocation cost.

items.title: Dubai Hills Estate
items.text: Family-friendly master-community logic with apartments, villas, parks and school/commute relevance.

items.title: Arabian Ranches
items.text: Relevant for villa and townhouse buyers who prioritize space, community and long-term family living.

items.title: JVC / Jumeirah Village Triangle
items.text: Useful for families comparing apartment/townhouse affordability with central access.

items.title: Dubai Creek Harbour / Town Square
items.text: Good to compare when budget, newer communities and family lifestyle tradeoffs matter.

items.title: 2–3 bedroom apartments
items.text: Good for families who want lower maintenance, amenities and easier city access.

items.title: Townhouses
items.text: Useful for families needing more space without moving into full luxury villa budgets.

items.title: Villas
items.text: Best for privacy, outdoor space and long-term family living if budget allows.

items.title: Off-plan family communities
items.text: Can work with payment plans, but handover risk and school timing must be checked.

decision_cards.title: Budget must include relocation cost
decision_cards.text: Do not calculate only property price; add fees, furnishing, school deposits and moving costs.

decision_cards.title: School and commute come first

decision_cards.title: Handover timing can break relocation plans

risks.title: Risks
risks.body: The main family relocation risks are choosing the project before the school/commute plan, underestimating service charges and furnishing cost, relying on unrealistic handover timing, buying too far from daily needs, or choosing size without checking long-term resale liquidity.

budget_logic.title: Budget logic
budget_logic.body: Family relocation budget should include purchase price, payment plan, transaction fees, service charges, furnishing, school costs, moving costs and emergency timing buffer.

items.question: What are the best Dubai areas for family relocation?
items.answer: Family-friendly options depend on schools, commute, budget and lifestyle. Common areas to compare include Dubai Hills Estate, Arabian Ranches, JVC, Town Square, Dubai Creek Harbour and selected villa or townhouse communities.

items.question: Should a relocating family buy an apartment, townhouse or villa?
items.answer: The best property type depends on budget, family size, school location, commute, outdoor-space needs and whether the buyer wants ready or off-plan property.

items.question: What should families check before buying?
items.answer: Check schools, commute, community maturity, handover, service charges, payment plan, property size, outdoor space, documents and total relocation costs.
